title: A valid full-tenant Override import stalls the client at 'Uploading… 50%' with no response, though it applies in the background
stepsToReproduce: Open Corporate Pricing > Product Group Override on a healthy office (e.g. 4107) and select the location.
Click Export to download the full tenant-wide CSV (about 9,000 rows, ~570 KB).
Edit one row's Override Price, remove the single empty-Override-Price row, and save the file.
Open the Import dialog, attach the edited full file, and click Upload.
Watch the upload progress indicator and the dialog.
expectedBehavior: The upload completes and the dialog closes (or shows a success result) so the user knows the import finished.
actualBehavior: The dialog sticks at 'Uploading… 50%' and the client request never returns, so the dialog never closes and the user gets no completion signal. The change IS applied on the server in the background (visible after a page reload), but the stuck UI makes it look failed. A minimal file (header plus one row) does not stall — it returns a normal response in about two seconds — so the stall is specific to the large full-tenant upload.
mcpEvidence: Live-verified 2026-07-23 on office 4107: a minimal one-row import returns HTTP 200 in ~2.1s, while the full-tenant dump exhibits the stuck-50% behavior described. The progress bar also jumps to 50% within ~263 ms of clicking Upload (before any bytes are sent), so the 50% figure is a fixed UI state, not real progress. The round-trip test (TC-CPR-OVR-053) deliberately imports a minimal file to avoid this stall.
baselineEvidence: The Product Group Override import is net-new on this environment with no legacy-site equivalent; classified from live application DOM and network evidence, not a legacy regression.
